title: Spinosaurus aegyptiacus, digital reconstruction
creator: Julian Johnson-Mortimer
attribution: Spinosaurus by Julian Johnson-Mortimer, CC BY 4.0, via Sketchfab
modifications: 651.4k-triangle archive with six original diffuse maps — five 4096 px skin/detail sheets (head, body, legs, tails, detail) and a 512 px eye. Material texture indices were repaired after import so each map loads on its intended surface; the maps are preserved at full resolution as WebP. Geometry unmodified on the exhibition mesh. No normal, roughness or ambient-occlusion maps are supplied by the archive. Studio lighting and a subtle display grade are applied in the hero; the original skin colours are retained.

title: Spinosaurus skin, detail and eye maps
creator: Julian Johnson-Mortimer
attribution: Skin and eye textures by Julian Johnson-Mortimer, CC BY 4.0, via Sketchfab
modifications: Six original maps supplied with the licensed archive — five 4096 px skin/detail sheets (head, body, legs, tails, detail) and a 512 px eye — are preserved at full resolution and encoded as WebP. Texture indices were repaired after import so the maps bind to their intended materials. For the bind-pose rig only, empty UV-margin texels are filled by cloning nearby painted skin; the exhibition mesh keeps its original UVs. The eye map is the author's original iris. No AI-generated textures.

title: Spinosaurus aegyptiacus — bind-pose rig study
creator: Julian Johnson-Mortimer; armature and weights by MESOZO
attribution: Spinosaurus by Julian Johnson-Mortimer, CC BY 4.0, via Sketchfab; bind-pose rig by MESOZO
modifications: The author's linked bind-pose archive (spineBind.fbx) was rigged in Blender with a 30-bone armature (29 deform bones plus a root): root/hips, spine_01, spine_02, chest, neck, head, jaw, eight tail bones, two four-bone hind limb chains and two three-bone forelimb chains. Explicit distance-based weights are assigned per anatomical region (head, body, tail, legs, teeth/claws), with no automatic-weight fallback. Two eye discs were reconstructed from the author's original 512 px eye texture. The mesh is unmodified apart from join/UV handling, smoothed normals and the eye/pupil geometry; exported as a skinned glTF with the five 4K skin maps and the original eye map. Used only in the internal model laboratory; no animation is included.
